method: Official NASA PSI search-indexed pages used for the six DOI-confirmed records; a second review of official NASA programme and investigation material was conducted for the remaining 18. Direct opening of other JS-rendered PSI record pages returned no searchable content and exact search-index matches could not be confirmed. Secondary sources corroborate research topics, not PSI landing-page DOIs. No raw datasets or papers were downloaded.

PSI-62.title_on_nasa_psi: Concurrent Flame Spread Modeling using Flamelet Generated Manifolds in Microgravity with Comparison to BASS Experiments using Two-Color Tomography
PSI-62.verification_scope: Official NASA PSI indexed title, identifier and DOI confirmed; ground-based modelling investigation, not evidence of a new flight experiment; raw data not accessed.

caution: Six PSI ID/title/investigation DOI pairs verified from their official indexed investigation pages. The other 18 have supporting official NASA research/programme context only, without independently confirmed investigation landing-page DOI or citation control. Do not assume a programme page verifies a particular PSI ID/DOI. Original catalogue is unchanged.
